role: General secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (2012–present); president of China (2013–present)
summary: Xi advocates Communist Party leadership, socialist modernisation and national reunification. He supports a mixed economy under party leadership, technological development, cultural continuity and a larger developing-country voice in international governance.

universal-healthcare.rationale: He calls for comprehensive universal medical insurance and a strengthened public-health system.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources reviewed.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: In "The Invisible Hand and the Visible Hand" (Economic Development) he argues the market should play the decisive role in allocating resources and government should cut direct involvement in micro-level allocation, but he stresses the government is not replaceable and that Party leadership is a feature of the system, so he does not hold that markets simply do better than governments.

public-ownership.rationale: The Third Plenum explanatory notes (All-round and Deeper-level Reform) insist public ownership keeps the leading role, state capital keeps controlling stakes in natural-monopoly industries, and state capital is directed to key sectors vital to national security and the economy; he pairs this with opening competitive segments and mixed ownership.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The 20th Congress report says taxation, social security and transfers should regulate income distribution, the personal income tax system be improved and excessive income be adjusted; it gives no tax-rate commitment.

unions-good.rationale: In "Hard Work Makes Dreams Come True" he calls unions homes for workers, an important pillar supporting the government and tells them to uphold workers legitimate rights including migrant workers and promote harmonious labour relations; he places unions firmly under Party leadership.

property-fundamental.rationale: The Third Plenum explanatory notes (All-round and Deeper-level Reform) state that property rights of both the public and non-public sectors are inviolable; the 20th Congress report promises to protect private enterprises property rights by law. He frames this inside socialist public ownership, so it is not an absolute right.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The Third Plenum explanatory notes call for stronger market oversight and fair competition rules; the 20th Congress report promises stronger action against monopolies and law-based regulation of capital, and his government carried out regulatory crackdowns on technology, tutoring and property firms from 2020-21.

cut-welfare.rationale: In "Accelerate the Development of Housing Security and Supply" he warns against total welfare dependence and wants the market to meet most housing demand, while expanding social security and basic housing elsewhere; evidence points both ways.

worker-ownership.rationale: He endorses private businesses and equal treatment of different ownership forms.

surveillance-ok.rationale: "Safeguard National Security and Social Stability" calls for an impregnable anti-terrorism network and for terrorists to be hunted down, and his government built mass surveillance including in Xinjiang under the Strike Hard campaign.
